title: Hands of Fate
description: A surreal painting featuring two large hands reaching toward the center, one blue and one red-orange. Between them float three stylized female faces with green hair and yellow eyes, surrounded by swirling orange and purple patterns, spirals, checkerboard motifs, and faint city silhouettes in the background.
